description: Unofficial Hakurei Reimu fan-art companion inspired by Touhou Project. Red-and-white chibi shrine-maiden design with an opaque white undershirt and covered shorts as modest drawing adaptations. Nine original animations include paper pinwheel folding and repair, a sleeve-guided foam-ball display, paper ribbon folding and a soft hop. No official animation or affiliation is implied.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
